assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are maintainer-provided provisional constraints (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough). They are used only for generation, visualization and provisional self-check, never as official redline, approval basis or precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, length and phasing metrics are recomputed from provisional geometry in EPSG:4548. When official polygons arrive, geometry, metrics, figures, drawings and HTML must be regenerated as a whole. The organizer data gap itself does not block content scoring.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official or cleared SITE_BOUNDARY / KEY_AREA polygons added to the repository.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, building density control, green-ratio control, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation. FAR, total floor area and building height remain status=unknown in metrics.json.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions or official design brief attachments become available.

assumptions.statement: The land-use partition (90 cells) is a topology-safe conceptual proposal derived from the provisional boundary by a single cut-line network; it is not statutory zoning and does not assert parcel-level demolition/renovation conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Land-use areas and ratios are design-intent values recomputable from geometry/land_use.geojson; they must be revisited once official boundary and existing-conditions data arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official boundary, existing land-use survey or regulatory plan data becomes available.

assumptions.statement: All road features are concept centerlines without redline, alignment or engineering-feasibility claims. The road_area_sqm metric is an estimate using an assumed average concept width of 12 m.
assumptions.impact: road_centerline_length_m is recomputable; road_area_sqm is low-confidence and must not be used for statutory or engineering claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official road network / redline data becomes available.

assumptions.statement: The 600 building footprints are procedurally generated concept bases expressing scale intent and retain/renovate/new-build classification only; they are not a building inventory or approved design.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_density express concept scale; building_density is low-confidence because the boundary is provisional and footprints are conceptual.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Existing-building survey or approved design conditions become available.
